title: CKM Matrix Values Found from Fibonacci Numbers
content: The author shows that it is possible to obtain the CKM transition probabilities from the values of quark masses. For example in order to obtain the probability for the transition from the quark d to the quark u the author shows that this value can be found from the value of the mass of the quark u and the values of the masses of quarks that can transform into the u quark. Alternatively, every value of the CKM matrix can be found from few Fibonacci numbers. The author shows how these two findings are related.
